Title: Table rounds a constrained value across the requirement's threshold, so the displayed number contradicts the verdict
Resolution: Digits keep a value on its own side of a threshold (fmtAgainst)
Evidence: I5: 300 violations in 174,159 displayed-value checks (seed 1, 3000 scenarios), across all six numeric headlines. Examples: PC price 50.99 shows "51" and is PASS for price < 51 (Strict, default view); PLA Basic/PLA Matte 27.99 show "28" PASS for <= 27.99; PC-PBT HDT 107.4 shows "107" PASS for > 107.2; PLA Lite strength 53.05 shows "53" for > 53; PCTG modulus 1.755 shows "1.75" PASS for > 1.75; ASA-GF modulus 2.758 shows "2.76" FAIL for >= 2.76; PET-CF price 115.98 shows "116" FAIL for >= 116. The requirement pill (labels.js:88, 4 decimals) never caused a crossing (I5-rounding-pill 0).

Title: Every Ashby render leaks a Plotly plot and a window resize listener; the page slows and its heap grows with each filter change on the chart
Resolution: One resize listener; heap flat over 800 renders (was 569 MB)
Evidence: No Plotly.purge anywhere in app/js; drawPlot calls Plotly.newPlot(gd, ..., {responsive: true}) (app/js/ui/ashby.js:653-654) on a fresh #plot div each render, and renderAshby replaces the host with innerHTML (ashby.js:137) without purging the old one, so Plotly's window 'resize' handler keeps each detached plot alive. Measured in headless Chrome (scratch leak probe, Strict/Explore toggled on the Ashby lens, GC forced before each sample): window resize listeners 2 -> 204 -> 606 -> 1408 and JS heap 14 -> 96 -> 254 -> 569 MB after 200, 400 and 800 renders. In the fuzz, tabs that were never reloaded saw the in-app scenario load grow from about 17 ms (first 20 scenarios) to an average of 156 ms over a 3000-scenario run; the harness now reloads each tab every 40 imports (--recycle).
Repro: Open the Ashby lens, click Include uncertain / Confirmed only a few hundred times, then check getEventListeners(window).resize.length in DevTools (grows by one per render).

Title: Uncertified screening classes: HDT this-material is 2 cases short; semicrystalline brackets govern no material today
Resolution: Certification needs more measured cases; candidate sources listed in sources/open-items.md
Evidence: dist/db.json meta.estimateModel: tensileStrengthXY this-material held 10 (0/0 misses), hdt045 this-material 18 (1/1), bracketScreening semi-filled 12 (2 high, pHigh 0.035), semi-unfilled 3, elastomer 1; reproduced independently with kindOf. Only M004 PLA Lite (amorphous, certified) has an unstated-load hdt045 headline. Public TDS found for second grades of M027 ABS, M031 ASA, M035 PC, M036 PC FR, M067 PET-CF, M024 PETG-CF, M048 PAHT-CF (e.g. PolyLite_ABS_TDS_V5.3.pdf p3 "Heat deflection temperature ISO 75 0.45MPa 99.6 °C"). New semi-filled pairs from Fiberon PET-CF17 ("1.8MPa 105 °C", "0.45MPa 147.5 °C") and Ultrafuse PAHT CF15 ("HDT at 0.45 MPa (dry) 145 °C", "1.8 MPa (dry) 92 °C") exceed the current +39 °C bracket top, so the semi-filled class will likely widen, not certify. Elastomer HDT pairs are not realistically obtainable.

Title: PP headline and facet describe HyperLite PP, a lightweight-additive product, as unfilled polypropylene
Resolution: m25: PP Lightweight
Evidence: X-Hyperlite-PP-TDS-v1 p1 "Density ISO 1183 g/cc 0.81", "Tensile Modulus ISO 527 MPa 1650", "Tensile Elongation, Break ISO 527 % 13"; R-TRINITY3DS-HYPERLITE-PP "a specialty additive which enables ultra low density", "0.75g/cc". I-PP-TDS p1 "Density ... O.89", "Elongation At Break % ISO527 460", "Flexural Modulus MPa ISO178 390". M082 PP headlines (density 810, modulus 1.65 GPa, elongation 13 %, HDT 94 °C) all cite G082-01; compiled facet reinforcement = unfilled; G082-01 Composition says "A lightweight variant, not unfilled PP". PLA Aero/ASA Aero are separate materials with Modifier Foaming. Splitting would make iSANMATE PP (HDT 92 °C, load not printed) the PP headline, putting the uncertified semi-unfilled bracket in charge.
